description: all img2cli-owned windows. capture: its webview subscribes to the warm-window 'capture-refresh' event, and core:event listen is ACL-gated per window label — an unlisted window's JS listeners are silently denied (root cause of the v0.4.4–v0.4.8 'dead overlay': the webview was never dead, it was deaf). pin-* (glob): U5 edge-resize needs core:window:allow-start-resize-dragging, which core:default does NOT include (its window set is read-only getters)
